rules.name: Enemy of the Dawn
rules.description: The Dragonborn adds [GREEN] to all Attacks performed against members of the Dawnguard Faction.

infoLinks.name: Lord Harkon: Progenitor of the Volkihar

rules.name: Power Takes Precedence
rules.description: Lord Harkon may not be included in the same party as any model that is not either a member of the Clan Volkihar Faction or Neutral.  Furthermore, Harkon and any friendly Vampire within 6" may add [GREEN] to their Blood Magic Skill Tests.

infoLinks.name: Lord Harkon: Progenitor of the Volkihar (Leveled)

rules.name: Know Your Place...
rules.description: When Vingalmo performs the Rally Command, he may immediately reassign the removed Shaken token to any enemy Follower or Minion Adversary within 6" and Line of Sight.

rules.name: Elf Enmity (1)
rules.description: Orthjolf may not be included in any Party if the Champion is an Elf. [...] Furthermore, when targeting an enemy Elf with an Attack or Spell, Orthjolf may reroll the Skill die once if he scores a [CRITICAL FAIL].

rules.name: Thrall Master
rules.description: Friendly Clan Volkihar Thralls add [YELLOW] to Attacks if within 6" of an Ancient Vampire which does not have a full Health Reserve.

rules.name: Thrall Feeder
rules.description: As a Special Action, the Vampire Mistwalker may target one Volkihar Thrall within 3" and Line of Sight.  The target Thrall suffers [YELLOW] damage (ignoring Armor Rating), then the Vampire Mistwalker restores 1 point to each of its Reserves.
